4 أَسْفَهْتُهُ I found him to be سَفِيه [i. e. lightwitted, &c.]. (TA. [There said to be tropical; but I see not why.]) ―
-b2- أَسْفَهَكَ ٱللّٰه الضْلَرRَّرَابَ (assumed tropical:) May God make thee to drink of the beverage, or wine, without having thy thirst satisfied thereby: or أَسْفَهَهُ ٱللّٰهُ God made him, or may God make him, to drink without having his thirst satisfied: (S, accord. to different copies:) or اسفه ٱللّٰهُ فُلَانَّا المَآءَ God made, or may God make, such a one to drink much water. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
